items.brief: Japanese stablecoin firm JPYC raises $38M in Series B
items.why: Stablecoin funding round to expand adoption and ecosystem.

items.brief: Robinhood Chain reaches $774M TVL; tokenized assets at $27.6M
items.why: Chain launched for tokenized assets, which now comprise significant portion of value.

items.brief: Kraken's xStocks tokenized equities now support proxy voting rights
items.why: Tokenized equity product gains governance feature for eligible investors.

items.brief: Nomura's Laser Digital backs ZIGChain for onchain private credit in UAE
items.why: Investment in tokenized private credit infrastructure for onchain markets.

items.brief: Ondo Finance hires ex-Blockchain.com CFO for tokenized assets expansion
items.why: Leadership hire signals growth in onchain tokenized capital markets business.

items.brief: Mastercard pilots Crypto Credential for cross-border stablecoin payments
items.why: Major payment network expanding stablecoin infrastructure for trusted flows.

items.brief: Circle names BlackRock, DTCC as Arc validators; USDC at $73.3B circulation
items.why: Major institutions backing stablecoin validator set; stablecoin growth milestone.

items.brief: Yellow Card raises $40M to link banks to stablecoin processing
items.why: Infrastructure connecting traditional finance to stablecoin payment networks.

items.brief: Visa expands stablecoin on Visa Direct via zerohash partnership
items.why: Major payment network integrating stablecoin capabilities into existing infrastructure.

items.brief: Circle stock falls 3% despite earnings beat on Arc institutional adoption
items.why: Stablecoin issuer reports institutional uptake of tokenization layer 1.
